requirements.title: LCOBOUND COARRAY allocation/designator, DIM, and KIND restrictions
requirements.definition: COARRAY shall be a coarray; an allocatable COARRAY shall be allocated; a multipart designator shall have nonzero corank in the rightmost part-ref; DIM shall be an integer scalar in range one through the corank and its actual argument shall not be an optional dummy argument, disassociated pointer, or unallocated allocatable; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

requirements.title: LCOBOUND result kind, rank, and size follow KIND and DIM
requirements.definition: The LCOBOUND result is integer; KIND selects its kind type parameter, default integer is used without KIND, DIM present makes the result scalar, and DIM absent makes a rank-one array of size equal to the corank of COARRAY.

requirements.title: LCOBOUND returns lower cobounds by codimension
requirements.definition: With DIM present, LCOBOUND has the lower cobound for that codimension of COARRAY; with DIM absent, element i of the result has the lower cobound for codimension i.
